subject: Re: Project status notes
text: Thanks for your earlier reply. I’m sending a short update after reviewing the notes from last Tuesday. The survey data is now cleaned and mapped to the three priority areas. The first area, the east path, is ready for the small repair quote. The contractor confirmed they can start within two weeks if the permit paperwork is signed this week. The second area, the playground entrance, needs a revised photo because the original was blurry. I asked another volunteer to take another one, but the lighting may not be good until the afternoon, so I’ll send it tomorrow instead of this evening. The third area, the shared fence, has no new damage; we’re only waiting for the city inspector’s email, which they said might arrive by Friday. The community meeting date moved from the 12th to the 14th, so the flyers need another version. I can update the wording by noon if you approve the revised title: 'What’s next for the east path?' I kept the contact block the same. I also removed the old donation amount because it caused confusion, and replaced it with the phrase 'support details to follow.' No blockers yet, except the inspector email. If anything else changed on your side, reply before 4 p.m. so I can adjust the client summary before the weekend. I’ve attached the cleaned map as a PDF, not the spreadsheet link, because the old link required a login. That should keep the folder clear for the new team member.
